# Duks Juice

Duks Juice is a premium cold-pressed juice brand based in Accra, Ghana. We produce and deliver fresh natural juices, smoothies, wellness shots, cut fruits, cleanses, and gift packs. No additives, no preservatives. We serve retail customers, corporate events, bulk wholesale, and offer juice training.
